# Memo: Council Priorities for Q3 2025 Date: 2 July 2025 From: Office of the Mayor To: All department heads ## Top three priorities 1. Reduce overcrowding on peak-hour bus routes. 2. Bring NO2 air quality down to the 2025 target. 3. Reduce water loss in the supply network.

heading_path: Memo: Council Priorities for Q3 2025 > Decision needed from the Council
text: ## Decision needed from the Council Approve a permanent extension of peak-hour buses on overcrowded routes. Estimated annual cost: 1.2 million EUR. Deadline: 31 October 2025. The decision depends on the results of the Transit Agency pilot.

# Bus Network Redesign: Pilot Proposal Project lead: Maryam Nazari, transport planner Date: 16 June 2025 ## Goal Reduce peak-hour overcrowding so that no route exceeds the 85% load limit in the Transport Policy. ## Proposal - Pilot on Route 7 for 8 weeks, starting 4 August 2025. - Add 6 buses taken from the existing fleet. - Shorten the peak-hour interval between buses from 10 minutes to 6 minutes.

heading_path: Bus Network Redesign: Pilot Proposal > Why Route 7
text: ## Why Route 7 Passengers name Route 7 as the most overcrowded (see the passenger survey), and it has the most complaints this quarter. ## Open question The ridership report ranks Route 12 as the busiest route. The data must be checked before any permanent decision. Budget: see the cost estimate.

# Passenger Survey Results: Bus Network Unit: Bus Network Redesign Project Period: 2 to 13 June 2025 Respondents: 1,200 ## 1. Busiest route in the passengers' view Respondents were asked which route they find most overcrowded at peak hours. | Route | Share of respondents | |---|---:| | Route 7 | 41% | | Route 12 | 27% | | Route 3 | 14% | | Other routes | 18% | Result: Route 7 has the largest share.

heading_path: Passenger Survey Results: Bus Network > 2. Overall satisfaction
text: ## 2. Overall satisfaction Average overall satisfaction with the bus service: 3.1 out of 5. ## 3. Most requested improvements (multiple choice) - Shorter waits at peak hours: 58% - Real-time bus arrival information: 35% - Cleaner buses and better ventilation: 22% - Electric and quieter buses: 19% ## 4. Limitations The survey was held at main stops in the morning and evening, so off-peak travellers are under-represented.

# Route 7 Pilot: Test Report Author: Maryam Nazari, project lead Date: 10 October 2025 ## Setup - Period: 4 August to 28 September 2025 (8 weeks). - Route: Route 7. Six extra buses added from the existing fleet.

## Results | Measure | Before | During pilot | |---|---:|---:| | Average peak-hour load | 94% | 71% | | Average interval between buses at peak | 10 min | 6.5 min | | Passenger satisfaction (out of 5) | 2.7 | 3.9 | ## Cost Actual pilot cost: 298,000 EUR, against an estimate of 310,000 EUR.

heading_path: Route 7 Pilot: Test Report > Status of the data check
text: ## Status of the data check The comparison between tap-in data and survey results (action from the 18 June meeting) is still pending. ## Recommendation Extend the extra peak-hour buses permanently on Route 7. Route 12 was not piloted.
